name: Reefclaw (BB)

items.name: Death Frenzy
items.text: When the reefclaw is reduced to 0 hit points it can spend this reaction to make a claw Strike before dying.

items.name: Constrict
items.text: If the reefclaw has a creature Grabbed or Restrained, it can spend one action to crush them in its coils. The creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage depending on its DC 17 basic Fortitude save save.

items.name: Reefclaw Venom
items.text: A target that takes slashing damage from the reefclaw's claw Strike must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save save or take 1d6 poison damage.

items.name: Grab
items.text: When the reeflclaw succeeds at its claw Strike, it can use this action immediately after to attempt to Grapple the target. This Grapple doesn't apply or count toward the reefclaw's multiple attack penalty.

text: Reefclaws are aquatic monsters that resemble huge shrimp or lobsters. Though reefclaws can't speak, they are intelligent enough to understand the local language of humanoids near their hunting grounds.
